versions.changelog: DEPRECATED: This skill has been renamed to feishu-msg-reader. Please use that instead.

Initial release of feishu-interactive-card – fetch and inspect Feishu message content.

- Supports all message types, including interactive cards, text, posts, images, and merge_forward.
- Fetch messages by message_id, with optional thread context for better understanding.
- Implements workaround for Feishu's API limitation: retrieves thread context to access content behind "[Interactive Card]" messages.
- Flexible authentication: reads from config file, environment variables, or command-line token.
- Provides structured JSON output including sender, chat, parent/root info, and (if requested) full thread messages.
